verdict.rationale: LobeChat/LobeHub shows local Agent connection, desktop terminal access, and MCP connectors that could enable running commands, plus marketing lines hinting at large-scale agent-driven issue resolution ('500 open issues... 50 agents'), but there is no concrete documentation of git cloning, repo editing, or automated testing workflows tied to a coding agent. missing for 10: explicit repo/git integration, documented code-editing or test-running workflow, evidence of a coding-specific agent (e.g., Claude Code/Aider-style) being embedded rather than generic MCP/local agent connectors.
